newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Pacific Insurance sees Shenzhen branch gain.
newsitem.headline: China Pacific Insurance sees Shenzhen branch gain.

text.p: China Pacific Insurance Co's Shenzhen branch expects a 50.5 percent year-on-year earnings hike in 1997 to 48 million yuan, compared with 32.88 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Thursday.
The company's office in Shenzhen expects income from premiums to reach 576 million yuan in 1997, up 47.7 percent from 420.27 million yuan in 1996, the newspaper said.
China Pacific's market share in the southern boomtown hit 13 percent in 1996, up from 10 percent in 1995, it said.
The paper said the Shenzhen company plans to fuel future earnings growth through improved management, new insurance products and expansion of its life insurance business.
